nodes.description: Privileged owner address of UniswapExchange; set to msg.sender in constructor and gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of holder balances mutated by transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting sale participations per address, read by condition and incremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping of whitelisted addresses bypassing sale restrictions in ensure.
Private minimum sale size, written by init and read by condition.
Private maximum sale size, written by init and read by condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address, written by init and read by condition.
Privileged trading address whitelisted in ensure, set by setTradeAddress.
Public total token supply assigned from _supply in constructor.
Constant public decimals, 18.
Constant hardcoded Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards msg.sender as _from into transferFrom.
Internal view whitelist check comparing _from/_to against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale before falling back to condition.
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance, balance and whitelist checks then unchecked balance mutations.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit check against _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall with caller supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum scaled by decimals.
Owner-only bulk transfer looping over _tos with unchecked multiplication of _value and _tos.length.
Owner-only setter writing tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balances and unlimited router allowance.
Arbitrary low-level delegatecall a.delegatecall(b) executed in the token storage context.
Unchecked balance subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked balance addition balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length.
Unchecked allowance decrement allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
Low-level external call address(token).call(data) with optional return decoding in SafeERC20.
Attacker controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowance spender and transfer origin.
Parameter of transferFrom, source address for balance and whitelist checks.
Parameter of transferFrom, destination address credited.
Parameter of transferFrom, amount moved and used in unchecked arithmetic.
Parameter of batchSend, array of recipient addresses.
Parameter of batchSend, per-recipient amount multiplied unchecked with array length.
Parameter of delegate, target address for the delegatecall.
Parameter of delegate, calldata for the delegatecall.
Parameter of setTradeAddress written into tradeAddress.
Parameter of init, assigned to _saleNum.
Parameter of init, minimum sale amount before decimals scaling.
Parameter of init, maximum sale amount before decimals scaling.
Parameter of approve, allowance spender key.
Parameter of approve, allowance amount set.
Local variable in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length.
Local loop index in batchSend.
Local per-iteration recipient address in batchSend.
Private SafeERC20 helper that verifies contract code and performs the low-level token call.

per-recipient _value operand of the unchecked multiplication.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only meaningful as the source key used by transferFrom for balance and whitelist checks.
Parameter _to is only used as the credited balance key inside transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount consumed by transferFrom arithmetic and allowance decrement.
Parameter _tos is the recipient array iterated exclusively by batchSend.
Parameter value_batch is the per-recipient amount used only in batchSend arithmetic.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target supplied to delegate.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata supplied to delegate.
Parameter addr is written only into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
Parameter saleNum is assigned only to _saleNum inside init.
Parameter token is used only to compute _minSale inside init.
Parameter maxToken is used only to compute _maxSale inside init.
Parameter _spender is only the allowance key in approve.
Parameter value_approve is only the allowance amount stored by approve.
Local total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Local i is the loop index used only by batchSend.
Local _to is the per-iteration recipient used only by batchSend.
